purpose: Construct an ordered declarative representation of four cited Practice dynamics candidates without selecting or running a numerical or stochastic method.

required.statement: Validate the exact feature identity, four required keyed opaque inputs, ordered object population, and canonical provenance.
Preserve objects 070, 077, 084, and 092, their input and output identities, documentary order, payloads, reservations, and traceability.
Provide deterministic structural construction, validation, canonical serialization, deserialization, comparison, and trace inspection.

forbidden.statement: Do not numerically integrate, simulate, select a solver, infer stochastic laws, or create an executable loop from repetition wording.
Do not invent types, dimensions, units, thresholds, transitions, stop rules, durations, progressions, effects, or partial successful results.

deferred.statement: Scientific execution and evaluation require external providers; all candidate result semantics remain unresolved.

operations.purpose: Return the immutable ordered dynamics-candidate representation.

constraints.statement: All four values are independently required under candidate status and remain opaque.

preconditions.statement: The exact input ids 003-1 through 003-4 and objects 070, 077, 084, 092 are present in canonical documentary order.
Every input is supplied under candidate status with canonical contract, IR, test-plan, and source references.

postconditions.statement: All four source statements remain independent, ordered, opaque, and traceable.
No trajectory, integrated value, loop, transition, or scientific effect is emitted.

invariants.statement: The repetition-labelled object creates no executable repetition semantics.
No integration, stochastic, type, unit, threshold, duration, progression, or effect semantics are inferred.

steps: validate exact identities cardinality and provenance
preserve opaque values and documentary order

partial_order.before: validate exact identities cardinality and provenance
preserve opaque values and documentary order

prescription_basis: Only validation, exact order, preservation, complete metadata, deterministic structure, and atomic publication are observable.

error_contract.condition: Source error id invalid_feature_identity: the feature id is not TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-003.
Source error id missing_required_input: any of inputs 003-1 through 003-4 is absent.
Source error id invalid_input_type: a required input is not opaque.
Source error id missing_source_reference: any covered object lacks its canonical reference.
Source error id provenance_mismatch: identity, cardinality, order, or provenance differs from the canonical population.
Source error id structural_error: the declarative representation violates this contract.
Source error id external_executor_required: scientific execution is requested without an external executor.
Source error id external_evaluator_required: scientific evaluation is requested without an external evaluator.
Source error id implementation_out_of_scope: an undeclared method, sequence, repetition, transition, stop rule, or effect is requested.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the ordered declarative representation and stable errors.
Do not integrate, simulate, select a solver, or calculate a trajectory.
Internal architecture remains free when observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: All four scientific identities, candidate status, opacity, and documentary order remain distinct and exact.
Structural validity never authorizes a scientific trajectory or effect.

dependencies.purpose: Stable object, input, and output identities

notes: Conformance is structural and asserts no dynamics trajectory.
